names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 august, «Sfinții 7 Mucenici Macabei, cu mama lor Solomoni și dascălul lor Eleazar», with the rank words left off. The same site's life of the seven spells her name «Solomonia»; both forms are the source's own, and this is the one the calendar's line prints.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Αυγούστου, «Άγιοι Επτά Μακκαβαίοι, η μητέρα τους Σολομονή και ο διδάσκαλός τους Ελεάζαρος», with the rank word and the kinship clause left off. The page's sub-heading for her is «Αγια Σολομονη Μητερα Των Επτα Μακκαβαιων».

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue’s first heading for the Julian 1 August, „Седам Макавеја, Соломонија матер њихова и Елеазар свештеник.“ — матер њихова left off, a descriptor and not a rank, and already carried by the display name. **This book spells her Соломонија**, with the extra syllable, where the Greek is Σολομονή; the form is copied as printed.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 august — «Sfinții 7 Mucenici Macabei, cu mama lor Solomoni și dascălul lor Eleazar»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Επτά Μακκαβαίοι, η μητέρα τους Σολομονή και ο διδάσκαλός τους Ελεάζαρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the entry is the same company: the seven brothers, their mother Σολομονή and their teacher Ελεάζαρος, under Antiochus king of Syria. saint.gr dates it, «περί το 5327 από κτίσεως κόσμου ή 173 π.Χ.» — about 5327 from the creation of the world, or 173 BC — and gives the teacher's age as ninety; no `dates` object is proposed from that here, because the folder has none and a BC interval is a reading for the writer rather than a reader's by-the-way, and the figures are recorded in the life instead. It also enumerates the seven by name, with variants: «Αβείμ (ή Άβιβος), Αντώνιος (ή Αντωνίνος), Γουρίας, Ελεαζάρος, Ευσέβωνας, Αχείμ, Μάρκελλος (ή Σάμωνας, ή Εύλαλος ή Μάρκος)». The corpus keeps the seven as one folder from the Romanian pass and this reader does not split an existing folder; the seven names are recorded here and in the life and the question is left in the report. The page adds two relics: a portion of Eleazar at the monastery of Panteleimon on the Holy Mountain, and Solomone's body incorrupt in the patriarchal church of Saint George at the Phanar, with a portion at Xeropotamou. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints an apolytikion which names her by name, «σὺν τὴ μητρὶ Σολομονὴ τὴ ἁγία», and it is taken; its kontakion addresses the seven alone and is not taken here. The couplet the page prints for her calls her a first contender before Thekla.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.08.2026 (1. август ст. ст.) — „Седам Макавеја, Соломонија матер њихова и Елеазар свештеник.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, and the heading names her: „Седам Макавеја, Соломонија матер њихова и Елеазар свештеник.“. **The spelling is this book’s own**: it writes Соломонија where the Greek line gives Σολομονή and the Romanian Solomoni and the display name Solomone; copied as printed and not reconciled. матер њихова, their mother, is the descriptor the display name already carries and is no rank, so the stored form is the name alone. `death` about 180 BC, off „Сви чесно пострадаше за веру у једног живога Бога око 180 год. пре Христа.“, whose subject is all of them; the folder held no date. Her own end is „Најзад и мајка, када виде и свог последњег трогодишњег сина у огњу, и сама скочи у огањ и изгори, предавши душу Богу.“ — she saw her youngest son, three years old, in the fire and leapt in herself. `types` untouched at `martyr`: матер is not a rank. No row for Antiochus and none for the high priests; the three folders of this entry were already related to one another in both directions before this reading and nothing was added. No `locations`. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion: the day carries the verse only, which is Bishop Nikolai’s own and belongs to no person.

hymns.text: Pentru durerile sfinţilor, care pentru Tine au pătimit, fii Milostiv Doamne şi toate durerile noastre le vindecă, Iubitorule de oameni, rugămu-ne Ţie.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinţilor 7 fraţi Macabei, al mamei lor Solomoni şi al dascălului lor Eleazar», Glasul 1 — the one troparion the site prints for the company of the day

english.text: For the pains of the saints who suffered for You, be merciful, O Lord, and heal all our pains, Lover of mankind: this we pray of You.

hymns.text: Τῶν Μακκαβαίων τὸν ἐπτάριθμον δῆμον, σὺν τὴ μητρὶ Σολομονὴ τὴ ἁγία, καὶ Ἐλεάζαρ ἅμα εὐφημήσωμεν οὗτοι γὰρ ἠρίστευσαν, δι' ἀγώνων νομίμων, ὡς φρουροὶ καὶ φύλακες, τῶν τοῦ Νόμου δογμάτων καὶ νῦν ὡς καλλιμάρτυρες Χριστοῦ, ὑπὲρ τοῦ κόσμου, ἀπαύστως πρεσβεύουσι.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Επτά Μακκαβαίοι, η μητέρα τους Σολομονή και ο διδάσκαλός τους Ελεάζαρος», and it names all three parties of the entry: the seven, the mother Solomone and Eleazar

english.text: Let us praise together the seven-numbered company of the Maccabees, with their mother the holy Solomone, and Eleazar as well; for these were valiant through lawful contests, as wardens and keepers of the decrees of the Law, and now, as fair martyrs of Christ, they intercede unceasingly for the world.

death.note: The folder held no date of any kind, neither doxologia nor saint.gr giving a year in its prose. The Охридски пролог for 1. август ст. ст. closes its first entry „Сви чесно пострадаше за веру у једног живога Бога око 180 год. пре Христа.“ — all of them suffered honourably for the faith in the one living God about the year 180 before Christ. The subject is Сви, all of them, so the one sentence dates every holder of this entry; «about» is kept in the display and the interval is left flat, which is the shape `elisha-the-prophet` and `abraham-of-pechenga` carry (6 October 2026).
